issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one operator-reviewed C-SDLC v3 authority-transition decision.

## Primary deliverable

One operator-reviewed C-SDLC v3 authority-transition decision.

## Verification result

One decision record binds requirements 179 and 180, parity, canary rollback, observation evidence, and the explicit operator disposition.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one authority-transition decision; parity, canary, and observation are evidence inputs and do not close independently.

## Dependencies

- V3-E: #504

## Retained predecessor scope

- #179
- #180

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Requirements 179 and 180 are mapped
- [ ] v2-v3 parity is measured
- [ ] Canary rollback is exercised
- [ ] Cutover and retirement require operator approval

## Owned paths

- `csdlc-v3/tests/parity/**`
- `docs/tooling/csdlc-v3/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/csdlc-v3/v3-f/**`

## PVF lanes

- `parity-matrix`
- `migration-canary`
- `rollback`
- `observation-window`

## Stop conditions

- Parity is incomplete
- Rollback fails
- Operator cutover approval is absent

## Non-goals

- Silent v2 retirement
- Unsupported-platform claims
